description:
Music Before Bed | Bansuri Instrumental | 3 Hours of Soft, Unbroken Rest

The lights are off but your mind is still on. If you lie there replaying the day, or wake at 3am and cannot drift back, let this play quietly beside you.

This soft Indian flute music is designed to carry you down into deep sleep and keep the night gentle - slow, breathy and warm, with long quiet spaces between the notes.

Enjoy 3 hours of low bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) over a gentle tanpura drone, smooth transitions, no vocals and no sudden sounds to wake you.

▶ Keep the night going — the full Sleep Music playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199mx7da__pC4JseKqY856ABr
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for falling asleep, staying asleep, sleepless nights, light sleepers, bedtime reading, calming a busy mind at night, children's bedtime, meditation before sleep, naps, or quiet overnight background.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) with tanpura drone
Raga: Yaman (an open, expansive evening raga)
Style: Indian classical ambient
Mood: Soft, safe, drifting
Atmosphere: Lamp off, moonlight through the curtain, slow breathing
Duration: 3 hours

🎧 HOW TO USE
Start it as you switch off the lamp and set the volume just above silence. Let your breath lengthen with the flute. The music continues long after you fall asleep, so if you wake in the night it is still there to ease you back. Low speakers or comfortable sleep headphones both work well.
